gen-fs-styro-fs-public-sans: Public Sans spreads broad, open curves across the line, a plain sans that feels hefty and trustworthy. Styro's crowded retro letters are the louder voice.
gen-fs-styro-fs-supreme: Retro and crowded up top, Styro presses its letters nearly shut. And Supreme holds its shapes open in a crisp, heavy-looking band of text.
gen-fs-styro-manrope: Manrope reads bright and approachable, its curves gaping open and its single line gliding along like fine wire under the eye. Styro commands with tight retro bulk; Manrope simply lets light in.
gen-fs-styro-satoshi: Approachable, first of all: Satoshi's soaring x-height and open e never look squeezed. Over a long stretch the sans moves smoothly, every stroke cut to one width, while Styro's retro heading stays tightly closed and commanding.
gen-fs-styro-switzer: Styro's letters are pressed so close together that they feel crowded, with barely any gap in the e and c. Switzer's tall waist and wire-like strokes, a plain sans, keep every curve open where the heading shuts tight.
gen-fs-zina-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp, with generous space where curves meet the stem. Zina's fat downstrokes and threadlike hairlines give the pair its strongest quality, a striking refinement against the open body.
gen-gf-amita-fs-literata: Amita writes with the flat, even line of a fineliner, relaxed and hand-drawn in feel. But Literata, a text serif, brings bookish thick-and-thin rhythm with wide-open curved letters.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-fs-bespoke-sa: Architects Daughter looks hand-drawn and graceful, its s curves opening wide at both ends. And if that heading were made small, its unvarying stroke would fade next to Bespoke Sans's crisp, spacious letters.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-fs-literata: Graceful and relaxed, Architects Daughter writes with one unit-width stroke and wide-open s curves. Literata, a classic serif, answers with bookish, sophisticated contrast, like a flat brush held half-turned.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-bespoke-sans: Loose, squeezed-toothpaste lines greet the eye here. Bpmf Iansui does inviting hand-drawn warmth, and Bespoke Sans does sharp, refined precision with space between curve ends and stem.
